scope: Independent source and machine-evidence review of notification construction, ISR queue send, task zero-timeout queue receive, tick-age consumer gate, and PCM dispatch through callback or DSP entry cuts.

coverage: registered mode-1 and mode-0 callback entry cuts
fresh consumer age 0/40 and stale age 41
unsigned tick rollover at age 40 and 41
notification then RX partial rearm/TX busy return 9 then age-40 consumer with explicitly synthetic PCM mutation

assessment.source_and_bounded_behavior: No blocking defect found. Tick/context helpers, message fields, queue calls, consumer age subtraction, table literal, mode narrowing and callback reread align with the authenticated stock spans.
assessment.cut_label_clarification: AUDIO_WAKE means successful queue acceptance before the 0x449238 flags provider; AUDIO_QUEUE_LOG means the failure branch before 0x43d0ce. Neither label proves a wake or an actual log.
assessment.instrumentation: Broad memory observation diverges in Unicorn 2.1.4 after original memcpy; the scoped profile executes the skipped load and compares post-call queue bytes and pointer state. The discrepancy is retained as an engine/instrumentation limit and gets no coverage credit.
limits: No task wake/context switch, wait-list/unblock provider, initialized dispatcher table, registered callback body, or DSP body execution.
Queue state, tick progression, peripheral progress, and mutation scenarios use explicit synthetic fixtures.
No live scheduling, PCM ownership/lifetime, cache coherence, physical DMA, full-source coverage, or byte-identical firmware claim.
